attr.title: Digimon World 2003
attr.desc: A source port of Digimon World 2003 (PAL, SLES-03975), built from a matching decompilation of the game's own C and the PlayStation hardware models reimplemented for the host. Runs the original disc's data at 50 Hz, with a GLES renderer for the 3D and a byte-for-byte match with the software rasteriser on the VRAM.
attr.inst: Needs your own disc: Digimon World 2003 (Europe/PAL, SLES-03975). Copy the .cue AND the .bin into ports/dw3/game/ (on ArkOS that is /storage/roms/ports/dw3/game/) - any .cue/.bin pair works, the launcher finds it. Do not rename the .bin without editing the .cue. Nothing of the game ships with the port.
